classification: post-hoc method feasibility diagnostic; not physical calibration

profile_advance_rule: Advance to a paired profile comparison only if the pivot chart recovers at least one baseline-invalid start, or reduces median residual calls by >=20% in at least two strata among pairs valid in both methods, without any per-stratum valid-count loss.
reported_metrics: planned/valid/failed/abstained starts by chart and stratum
actual residual-function calls including finite-difference Jacobian probes
nfev/njev, best GLS objective, and point-force difference between charts
shared_covariance: same block vectors; 25% diagonal shrinkage and 1e-10 relative eigenvalue floor
shared_initialization: same Nt=32 three-static forward initializer; epsilon/scale starts are fixed below
shared_model: finite-Nt two-vacuum x three-static positive spectral trace; 67 coordinates
